name: Kerala Flash Flood — Kottayam District
description: Catastrophic riverine flooding triggered by IMD Red Alert rainfall in Kottayam district, Kerala.

timeline.narration: IMD Red Alert issued for Kottayam. Monitoring Meenachil River basin water levels. All sensors NOMINAL.
SURGE DETECTED: Meenachil River breach at Kottayam Collectorate upstream gauge. Water level +3.2m above danger mark.

fire.reason: IMD satellite thermal confirms flood inundation plume — Kottayam urban core submerged

timeline.narration: FLOOD HOTSPOT confirmed at Kottayam city centre. 3 wards submerged. NDRF team activation initiated.
Flood spread expanding. Secondary inundation reaching Pala Road and Changanacherry Highway corridor.

fire.reason: Residential colony inundated — Puthuppally area. Access roads cut off.

timeline.narration: Secondary flood cell at Puthuppally. 2,400 residents stranded. Roads blocked.
4km evacuation corridor activated. 85,000 civilians in flood risk zone. 12 relief camps operational.
NDRF 9th Bn Trivandrum alerted. 3 rescue boats + 1 helicopter en route. ETA 45 minutes.
Peak flood surge — river water now at Kottayam Medical College. Hospital evacuation in progress.

timeline.warning: Do NOT enter fast-moving flood water on foot. Use boat or rope systems only.
timeline.narration: Relief equipment catalogue issued. Dewatering operations begin at Medical College compound.
Hydrological model: Flood front projected to reach Vaikom by 1800 hrs if rainfall continues at current intensity.
IGNIS flood response coordinated. Real-time satellite water extent mapped. NDRF + State teams deployed.
